chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Yahya al-Halbi, from Shu'ayb, from Yazeed al-Sa'igh, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the women, do they inherit the land? He said: 'No, but they inherit the value of the construction.' I said: 'But the people will not be pleased with that.' He said: 'When we rule, and if they are not pleased, we will strike them with the whip. If they do not straighten out, we will strike them with the sword.'
ai.seo_question: Do women inherit land or the value of buildings in Shia jurisprudence according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the distinction between inheriting the land itself versus the value of the structures, a ruling that Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) linked to the authority of the Imamate. He emphasized that this distribution was not merely a legal technicality but a matter of divine governance, promising strict enforcement through disciplinary measures ranging from the whip to the sword if the community resisted this specific allocation during their era of direct rule.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Yahya Al Halby, from Shuayb, from Yazeed Al Saig who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the women, would they inherit the land?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, but they would inherit the value of the construction’. I said, ‘But the people would not be happy with that’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When we<sup>asws</sup> rule, and if they are not pleased, we<sup>asws</sup> would strike them with the whip. So if they are (still) not straightened, we<sup>asws</sup> would strike them with the sword’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from Yahya af-Halabiy from Shu’ayb from Yazid af-Sa’igh who has narrated the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of women if they inherit from land. He (the Imam) said, ‘No, but they inherit from the value of the building.’ I then said, ‘People do not agree with it.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘When we become in authority, if they did not agree, we will whip them and if they did not become straight we will use sword against them.’”
